settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your account preferences and settings
settings.theme_desc: Choose how the app looks to you. Select a single theme, or sync with your system.
settings.email_notif_desc: Receive email updates about your account
settings.upcoming_alerts_desc: Get notified 3 days before a subscription renews
settings.confirm_desc: Are you sure you want to save these preference changes? They will take effect immediately.

email_forwarding.title: Email forwarding
email_forwarding.description: Forward subscription receipts and renewal emails to your private Subtrak address.
email_forwarding.load_error: We couldn't load your forwarding address.
email_forwarding.inactive: Generate a private address to start forwarding billing emails.
email_forwarding.privacy: Only forward billing emails you want Subtrak to process. Never forward passwords, security codes, or unrelated personal messages.
email_forwarding.gmail_instructions: Add this address as a forwarding destination, complete Gmail's verification step, then create a filter for trusted subscription providers.
email_forwarding.outlook_instructions: Create an inbox rule for trusted subscription providers and choose Forward to or Redirect to this address.
email_forwarding.rotate_confirm_body: Your current address will stop working immediately. Update every mail rule that uses it.
email_forwarding.revoke_confirm_body: Your current address will stop accepting forwarded email. You can generate another address later.
email_forwarding.action_error: We couldn't update your forwarding address

slides.title: Welcome to Subtrak
slides.body: Keep recurring subscriptions and one-time purchases together, so you always know where your money goes.

slides.title: Add what you pay for
slides.body: Enter the amount, billing cycle, category, and start date. Subtrak handles recurring and one-time payments.

slides.title: Understand your spending
slides.body: See monthly and yearly costs, upcoming billing dates, spending history, and category breakdowns on your dashboard.

slides.title: Stay ahead of renewals
slides.body: Turn on email reminders for recurring payments. You can adjust reminders, currency, language, timezone, and appearance in Settings.
